title: Grilling
summary: Stress-tests your thinking with a relentless interview about a plan, decision or idea.
details: Use it when you want to stress-test a plan, decision or idea: Claude interviews you relentlessly, in rounds of up to 4 questions with recommended answers, working through a design tree until nothing is left assumed. Finding facts is Claude's job, not yours, so it looks things up itself instead of asking. It adds a skill folder that loads only when used; instructions only, so no code runs on its own.
risk: Instructions only; loads when used. No code runs on its own.
